info.title: Valdit VAT Validation API
info.description: An API for validating VAT numbers against the EU VAT VIES Service.
info.termsOfService: See the Valdit Terms and Conditions (https://www.valdit.com/en-gb/legal/terms-and-conditions)

scopes.vatnumberchecks:write: Create and Update VAT number Checks
Create and Update VAT number Checks

post.summary: Create a new VAT number Check
post.description: Creates a Business Entity and performs the first VAT number validation for a new VAT number.

parameters.name: newVatNumberCheck
parameters.description: Defines a new VatNumberCheck to add to the Valdit VAT Validation system

201.description: A Business Entity has been created successfully and a VAT number check has been performed

Location.description: URL pointing to the created Business Entity

202.description: A Business Entity has been created. The validation could not be performed at this time and has been deferred. The response contains preliminary data on the Business Entity and the VAT number validation results. The validation will be automatically repeated until a valid response has been received from the EU VAT VIES system.

Location.description: URL pointing to the created Business Entity

303.description: Duplicate. A Business Entity with the provided VAT number already exists. A GET or a PUT operation should be used instead of a POST

Location.description: URL pointing to the existing Business Entity

400.description: Bad Request. The VAT number check creation has failed. The response will provide information on why the call failed

401.description: Unauthorized. No OAuth 2.0 access-token was provided or the access-token was invalid or has expired

402.description: Payment Required: You have exceeded your monthly quota and the call could not be accepted

429.description: Too Many Requests: You have exceeded your daily quota

500.description: A server error has occurred. The response will contain additional information on the error

get.summary: Get the VAT number Checks for a Business Entity
get.description: Retrieves the existing information on the Business Entity and the records of all previous VAT number validations for this Business Entity

parameters.name: correlationId
parameters.description: If specified, will be echoed in the response. Can be used to correlate request and response, e.g. when using asynchronous calls

parameters.name: checkVatNumber
parameters.description: Indicates if a new VAT-number Check should be made before returning the results. Defaults to 'false'

200.description: Success. The Response contains the data on the Business Entity and all the the VAT number validation records for this Business Entity.

400.description: Bad Request. The response will provide information on why the call failed

401.description: Unauthorized. No OAuth 2.0 access-token was provided or the access-token was invalid or has expired

404.description: A Business Entity with the provided VAT number could not be found

429.description: Too Many Requests: You have exceeded your daily quota

500.description: A server error has occurred. The response will contain additional information on the error

put.summary: Update an existing VAT number Check
put.description: Updates the information on the Business Entity by performing a new validation and returns this new and all past validation records. The PUT operation can also be used to update the settings for a Business Entity

200.description: The Business Entity has been updated successfully and a new VAT number validation has been performed

202.description: The Business Entity has been updated. A new validation could not be performed at this time and has been deferred

Location.description: URL of the updated VAT number check.

400.description: Bad Request. The response will provide information on why the call failed

401.description: Unauthorized. No OAuth 2.0 access-token was provided or the access-token was invalid or has expired

402.description: Payment Required: You have exceeded your monthly quota and the call could not be accepted

404.description: A Business Entity with the provided VAT number could not be found

429.description: Too Many Requests: You have exceeded your daily quota

500.description: A server error has occurred. The response will contain additional information on the error
